record_fields.candidate: Exactly one named IRI, explicitly typed as the externally requested class or a source subclass
record_fields.declaredClass: Exactly one of the 77 core class IRIs, matching the external request
record_fields.title: At least one nonblank xsd:string or language-tagged literal
record_fields.subject: At least one IRI identifying the record subject/context; no truth inference
record_fields.source: At least one source IRI; presence alone does not establish truth or endorsement
record_fields.requestedTask: Optional on managed records, required on catalog-inspection task records; only CatalogInspection is supported

profiles.raw: No metadata constraints and no identity normalization; staging is not acceptance
profiles.managed-catalog: Nonempty external focus and expected-class request; named record identity and the specified metadata envelope
profiles.task-catalog-inspection: Managed metadata plus explicit CatalogInspection task; means metadata inspection only, never risk assessment or calculation readiness

identity: Normalize asserted named instance sameAs aliases; reject sameAs/differentFrom conflicts before validation. Reject identity assertions involving reserved model/application/RDF vocabulary IRIs so class names cannot be rewritten as instance aliases. Do not merge by equal labels. Blank record/candidate identities fail managed SHACL but are preserved raw.
taxonomy: Append only 66 source subclass triples. No domain/range, OWL existential, external import, or unique-name inference.
boundaries: Three optional catalog notions are retained raw, excluded from core class-specific profiles and rejected as managed declared classes.
scope_limits: Metadata belongs to the information record, not to the represented agent/object/event as an ontological requirement.
No universal subject/provenance/field rule is added to the conceptual ontology or OWL.
Task-specific risk inputs, scalar/scale/unit compatibility and full integration remain parent #5.
A source is an explicit locator, not proof of source accessibility, authority or scientific truth.
Scope is caller-declared; omitted records outside the explicit request are not claimed validated.
Each baseline row PASS applies only to managed catalog metadata or boundary exclusion under this policy.
schema_guard: Managed instance input must not supply RDFS schema, OWL equivalence or imports; source taxonomy is appended from the pinned model. Raw retains such input without admission.
focus_specialization: Effective shapes retain only reachable requested profiles; the generic allowed-class list is restricted to externally requested core classes, while each record retains its exact expected-class hasValue rule. Class selection never comes from untrusted data.
blank_focus: Blank record focus uses private caller-added targetSubjectsOf selector predicates, because blank-node targetNode is excluded by the pinned meta-schema. Input-supplied focus selectors reject before SHACL; effective data snapshots retain caller additions.
